row.notes: Whole body read. Inserts job_record into that block list and returns the error code; non-zero is written to the TLS errno chain and the errno trace ring. Caller 0x143abfcc0: enqueues one job under the critical section and takes this path when the worker count (queue+0x160) is negative, else pushes to a worker; caller 0x143ac3cf0: enqueues a batch of jobs from a range the same way. Record = {owner cookie queue+0x168, fn, arg, 0, two flag bytes}. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
